stories.title: «Nous n’avons pas de prix fixe des F-35, et c’est un problème», reconnaît Martin Pfister au micro de la SRF

en.title: "We don't have a fixed price for F-35s, and that's a problem," Martin Pfister acknowledges on SRF
en.summary: Swiss Defense Minister Martin Pfister admitted that no fixed price has been agreed with the United States for F-35 fighter jets, contradicting previous government statements. The total acquisition cost remains uncertain.

stories.title: Donald Trump s’attaque aux médias et tout le monde y perd

en.title: Donald Trump attacks the media and everyone loses
en.summary: The US president has banned CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from the White House, citing intolerance for opposing views. Other media outlets have expressed solidarity with the banned organizations.

stories.title: Schweizer Kulturhauptstadt – La Chaux-de-Fonds hofft auf eine Million Besucher

en.title: Swiss Cultural Capital – La Chaux-de-Fonds hopes for one million visitors
en.summary: La Chaux-de-Fonds aims to position itself as Switzerland's first cultural capital through 300 events across 70 locations.

stories.title: Russland-Sanktionen – EU streicht zwei Oligarchen von der Sanktionsliste – darum geht's

en.title: Russia Sanctions – EU removes two oligarchs from sanctions list – what's behind it
en.summary: EU member states have reached agreement on extending Russia sanctions after lengthy negotiations, with France securing removal of two oligarchs from the sanctions list.

stories.title: Rad-WM in Montreal – Trotz Küng-Defekt: Mixed-Staffel holt Bronze

en.title: Cycling World Championships in Montreal – Mixed relay wins bronze despite Küng mechanical
en.summary: Switzerland's mixed relay team secured a bronze medal at the cycling world championships in Montreal. A mechanical issue affecting Stefan Küng prevented the team from achieving a better result.

stories.title: Château gonflable, festival de musique, aéroport transformé en «dancefloor»: Capitale culturelle 2027, La Chaux-de-Fonds dévoile un programme hors normes

en.title: Inflatable castle, music festival, airport transformed into 'dancefloor': Cultural Capital 2027, La Chaux-de-Fonds unveils an exceptional program
en.summary: La Chaux-de-Fonds will become Switzerland's first Cultural Capital in 100 days, hosting 300 artistic events throughout 2027 in diverse and unexpected venues across the city.

stories.title: Die EU nimmt zwei russische Oligarchen von der Sanktionsliste – und schafft damit einen Präzedenzfall

en.title: The EU removes two Russian oligarchs from the sanctions list – setting a precedent
en.summary: The European Union removed Russian oligarchs Alischer Usmanow and Michail Fridman from its sanctions list. France, Luxembourg, and Slovakia pushed for the move, while Latvia initially resisted before ultimately conceding.

en.title: Road cycling world championships: Swiss mixed relay wins bronze
en.summary: Switzerland's mixed relay team secured a bronze medal at the world road cycling championships in Montreal, continuing its podium success from the previous year.

stories.title: Tanzen auf dem Flughafen, vielleicht eine spezielle Swatch – und auf jeden Fall viel Humor: Die erste Schweizer Kulturhauptstadt stellt ihr Programm vor

en.title: Dancing at the airport, perhaps a special Swatch – and definitely plenty of humor: Switzerland's first cultural capital presents its program
en.summary: La Chaux-de-Fonds, as Switzerland's inaugural Cultural Capital, is planning a comprehensive year-long program celebrating culture, self-reflection, and new beginnings while bringing the country together.

stories.title: Le Grand Conseil valide le choix du logiciel Epic pour les hôpitaux vaudois après un long débat

en.title: Grand Council approves Epic software selection for Vaud hospitals after lengthy debate
en.summary: Vaud's Grand Council approved replacing the digital patient file system at the CHUV and eleven regional hospitals with software from American company Epic after five weeks of parliamentary discussion.

stories.title: Le Grand Conseil vaudois valide le choix du logiciel américain Epic pour les hôpitaux du canton

en.title: Vaud's Grand Council Validates Choice of American Software Epic for Cantonal Hospitals
en.summary: Vaud's parliament approved the replacement of patient record systems with Epic software across the cantonal university hospital and eleven other healthcare facilities following weeks of debate.

stories.title: La Chaux-de-Fonds Capitale culturelle suisse débute dans trois mois et ouvre sa billetterie

en.title: La Chaux-de-Fonds Swiss Cultural Capital begins in three months and opens its ticket office
en.summary: La Chaux-de-Fonds will become Switzerland's Cultural Capital on December 31 with a ceremony featuring music, dance, and acrobatics. Tickets go on sale Wednesday for over 300 events across 70 venues, including unusual locations.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Siemens erhält Milliardenauftrag aus Österreich +++ UBS erzielt Einigung in niederländischem Altfall von Credit Suisse

en.title: BRIEF REPORTS - Economy: Siemens receives billion-euro order from Austria +++ UBS reaches settlement in Dutch legacy Credit Suisse case
en.summary: Siemens has secured a large contract from Austria. UBS has reached an agreement regarding a legacy issue related to Credit Suisse in the Netherlands.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Signa-Insolvenz: Zweieinhalb Jahre Haft für René Benko

en.title: LATEST DEVELOPMENTS - Signa insolvency: Two and a half years imprisonment for René Benko
en.summary: Austrian investor René Benko's real estate and retail empire has collapsed, with Signa Holdings and subsidiaries undergoing insolvency proceedings. Benko has been sentenced and is in custody.

stories.title: Weder Frankfurt noch London: Die Gefahr einer Immobilienblase ist in Zürich so gross wie sonst nirgends

en.title: Neither Frankfurt nor London: Real estate bubble risk is as high in Zurich as nowhere else
en.summary: Zurich's real estate prices continue rising while other major cities cool. The market is heavily dependent on cheap mortgages.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Der Mut zur unbequemen Wahrheit: Die Kriegsverhinderung in Europa verlangt einen gemeinsamen Willensakt

en.title: COMMENT - The courage for uncomfortable truth: Preventing war in Europe requires a joint act of will
en.summary: Russia is intensifying attacks on European democracies. To protect freedom and open debate, authorities must clearly identify the threat, including in Switzerland.

stories.title: «Empörend» – «Ich finde es wichtig, dass auf die negativen Folgen der Regulierung hingewiesen wird»: Die Aussagen von Sergio Ermotti geben im Ständerat zu reden

en.title: "Outrageous" – "I think it's important to point out the negative consequences of regulation": Sergio Ermotti's statements spark debate in the Council of States
en.summary: Parliament will decide Wednesday on UBS's future capital requirements in a critical decision for the major bank. The bank's chief has strongly criticized the responsible authorities in recent remarks.
